This is a lesson on one drum groove the [Backing Track](../../tools/backing-track.qmd) band plays: **Two-beat**. It is built up from a simpler pattern, one step at a time, and every step is played by the band and written out as it plays. How the examples work: press ▶ Play, switch players in and out with the buttons beside it, and read what the band will play on the staff underneath: the whole pass is written out when Play starts, before it sounds. The tempo slider at the bottom of the page slows everything down.

[All the accompaniment patterns](index.qmd) · [Drum grooves](index.qmd#drums)

## The pattern

Kick with the bass on 1 and 3, a soft snare with the chords on 2 and 4. In 3/4: kick on 1, snare on 2 and 3.

It belongs in *Boom-chick*, *Country train beat*, *Folk carol*, *Freylekhs / polka* and *Ragtime*. Here it is in the boom-chick style with the whole band. Switch the other players off to hear it alone.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="folk" data-chart="G|C|D|G" data-tempo="104" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Drum groove:" data-choices='[{"label":"Two-beat","opts":{"groove":"boomchick"}}]'></div>

## Step 1: Hi-hat: quarter notes

Start with something simpler. Closed hi-hat on every beat, kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4. The first rock beat. In 3/4: hi-hat on every beat, kick on 1, snare on 3.

This is a pattern of its own: [the lesson on it](drums-hhquarters.qmd) takes it further. Here it is only a step on the way, slowly. The drums play alone first; switch the bass and chords on when it is steady.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="folk" data-chart="G|C|D|G" data-tempo="72" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Step:" data-choices='[{"label":"Hi-hat: quarter notes","opts":{"groove":"hhquarters"}}]'></div>

## Step 2: Two-beat, slowly

Now the pattern itself. Compare it with the step before: press each button while the band plays and watch what changes on the staff.

**How to play it.** Kick with the bass on 1 and 3, a soft snare with the chords on 2 and 4. In 3/4: kick on 1, snare on 2 and 3. Play it under the boom-chick of the guitar.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="folk" data-chart="G|C|D|G" data-tempo="72" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Compare:" data-choices='[{"label":"Two-beat","opts":{"groove":"boomchick"}},{"label":"Hi-hat: quarter notes (the step before)","opts":{"groove":"hhquarters"}}]'></div>

## Step 3: Up to tempo, with the band

The whole band, at 104 beats a minute. Play along, then switch the band's drum kit off and take the part yourself.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="folk" data-chart="G|C|D|G" data-tempo="104" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="drums bass" data-choice-label="Drum groove:" data-choices='[{"label":"Two-beat","opts":{"groove":"boomchick"}}]'></div>

## Step 4: In 3/4

The same pattern in a waltz: three beats to the bar. Listen for what it keeps and what it drops when the bar is a beat shorter.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="folk" data-chart="C|C|F|F|G7|G7|C|C" data-tempo="120" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="drums" data-meter="3/4" data-choice-label="Drum groove:" data-choices='[{"label":"Two-beat","opts":{"groove":"boomchick"}}]'></div>

## How it relates to the other patterns

- **Builds on:** [Hi-hat: quarter notes](drums-hhquarters.qmd).
- **Leads to:** [Train beat](drums-train.qmd), [Waltz in one](drums-waltz.qmd): the patterns that use this one as a step.
- **The same idea elsewhere in the band:** [Root and fifth](bass-alt.qmd) (bass line), [Boom-chick / oom-pah-pah](chords-oompah.qmd) (comping rhythm), [Fingerpicking: thumb, pinch-and](chords-prine.qmd) (comping rhythm), [Fingerpicking: Travis pattern](chords-travis.qmd) (comping rhythm).
- **Plays with, in boom-chick:** [Root and fifth](bass-alt.qmd) (bass line), [Boom-chick / oom-pah-pah](chords-oompah.qmd) (comping rhythm).
- **Other drum grooves in the Folk, rock and pop group:** [Bo Diddley beat](drums-bodiddley.qmd), [Waltz in one](drums-waltz.qmd), [Rock backbeat](drums-rock.qmd), [Pop backbeat](drums-strum.qmd), [Ballad](drums-ballad.qmd), [Four on the floor](drums-dance.qmd), [Motown](drums-motown.qmd), [Train beat](drums-train.qmd).
